definition.help: Eligibility is collection time, so fees earned before start may qualify when collected inside the window. Only actual positive fees accrued, never principal or estimates. Credits belong to actual position owners/routers and are paid from finite prefunding. Rates are ppm and caps separate raw-currency amounts per credited callback. End stops new credits; owed credits stay payable and only unused budget refunds.
